title: Independently verify the fixed balanced caller Laurent endpoint
body:
## Result
Independently checks the exact **353-event, 34-field, 19-stage caller** retained from PR6348. Reverse-functional substitution and a separately implemented forward-column engine agree on every one of its **1,156 Laurent transfer polynomials**: 34 advertised diagonal monomials and 1,122 zero off-diagonal cells. All original inputs remain arbitrary.

The ring is Z[Q±1,D1±1,…,D19±1], with distinct commuting units and no finite-order Q quotient. Complete dictionary equality establishes the formal identity; a common normalized matrix digest summarizes it. The primary also derives the event determinant and matches the diagonal product, (D1…D5)^6(D6…D19)^8.

This checks the **formal endpoint premise deliberately excluded by invoice PR6359**. It does not establish the physical LOCAL/QUERY/IDLE interfaces, native phases or contacts, stage commutativity/fresh axes, erasure, complete funding/compiler/outer admission, or a newκ. All five framework assumptions and selected6030 remain.

## Evidence
- Four registered Python3.12.14 normal/optimized commands pass, with exact typed receipts and separate code/proof reviews.
- Seven primary and eight oracle legal-sequence controls produce actual coefficient witnesses. The oracle's Q_POWER sign flip differs by four; its formal witness may vanish under Q^4=I and is not a physical failure claim.
- Read-only package-only Git-free/empty-PATH replay passes; ten source-corruption and two typed-receipt controls reject.
- All five exact canonical source origins, committed bytes/modes, declared ancestry and self-contained export are checked.

[Source bindings, proof, complete receipts, reproduction commands and remaining questions](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/d3f45af07fa75c260819ad630f4338e761d2b368/research/balanced-caller-endpoint-audit). Hosted CI and human acceptance remain separate.

## Task, overlap and credit
**Changed** joint-query-controller card: independent fixed-endpoint verification rather than a new-demand construction. Taking [handoff19344470](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19344470); [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19344535).

Source6348 is archived at9894015d6f380206f990ad5fd14bc49bbd26b0d0; the exact caller is retained at refreshed canonical main7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a, blob1f2e375b24aba5fb25580dfea7fab7a2049f3eb8. Priority8/selected6030 unchanged. Submission covered326openPRs, targeted all-state/source/intake/selected/prior-batch coverage and visible handoffs; coverage remains bounded/non-atomic, not a novelty certificate. Older18-call and lifting audits concern different words. The author already provides a complete forward replay and four-field/tree proof; this is new independent exact-source evidence, not discovery of generic Laurent mathematics or a predecessor flaw.

Credit Ali Romman with OpenAI Codex assistance, Cinna Davis/P104 local-query interface authors, PR6167/5544/6144/native lineage, Clear1nsight5550, flyingviper5717, Matarener5442,4457,selected6030 reviewers and the complete retained NOTICE. New reverse/forward audit, controls and proof review: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and three bounded agents. Same-session reviews are author-side evidence.

Next: bind one actual changed native-stage/contact to the declared LOCAL operator and complete source-specific funding/compiler/outer obligations. No merge, closure or frontier change; maintainer edits disabled.
